title: The Mars Sovereignty Crisis
premise: A connected ten-episode opening season where the Mars independence referendum triggers political, legal, labor, market, climate, and scientific ripples across the 2147 world system.
quality_target: International-level premium news broadcast with Apple-inspired UI polish, named people, named institutions, exact source labels, and causal continuity.

episodes.title: Mars Votes for Independence From Earth
episodes.purpose: Launch the channel and establish the Mars independence crisis as the first major world event.

episodes.title: Earth Union Opens Emergency Hearing on Mars Sovereignty
episodes.purpose: Show Earth institutional response and introduce legal stakes.

episodes.title: CEO Jiang Lau Warns Mars Vote Could Shake Energy Markets
episodes.purpose: Show market and corporate consequences through a named executive and energy infrastructure angle.

episodes.title: Lunar Oxygen Strike Expands After Mars Autonomy Debate
episodes.purpose: Connect Mars autonomy to Luna labor rights and life-support pricing.

episodes.title: Synthetic Rights Tribunal Receives Petition Over AI Voting on Mars
episodes.purpose: Introduce AI citizenship, memory identity, and voting rights.

episodes.title: Outer Belt Cooperative Offers to Mediate Earth-Mars Talks
episodes.purpose: Expand the crisis beyond Earth and Mars into asteroid trade diplomacy.

episodes.title: Pacific Floating Cities Activate Storm Shields
episodes.purpose: Broaden the world with a major Earth climate story and link it to energy-grid stress.

episodes.title: Europa Probe Detects Third Repeating Signal Beneath Ice
episodes.purpose: Introduce premium science-desk storytelling and a longer mystery arc.

episodes.title: Mars Independence Result Delayed After Settlement Data Dispute
episodes.purpose: Escalate Mars story through election integrity and remote settlement verification.

episodes.title: Earth, Mars, and Luna Enter Emergency Negotiations
episodes.purpose: Season-one culmination tying together sovereignty, energy, labor, and legal ripples.
